- `RAG/RETRIEVAL`: indexes, vector or lexical search, task fingerprints, keyword routing, semantic retrieval, file/context selection, and corpus construction. Record the corpus, query, selection rule, and where retrieved material enters generation.

- `MODEL-ROUTING`: model endpoints, roles, fallback/secondary calls, selection logic, parallel calls, and how outputs are combined. Report configuration mechanics without treating model names alone as a strategy.

83: ## REQ-3 implementation notes
84: 
85: - Formulas are stored verbatim in `cells.value` and evaluated on read

87:   persist with the expression. Formula cells add a `display` field; literal cells
88:   keep the existing `{row,col,value}` shape.
89: - Relative/absolute reference translation is shared by range copy and later REQ-4.
90: - Validation rules are stored in `validation_rules` and enforced atomically for
91:   grid edits, pastes and range moves; the 0-to-100 numeric case returns
92:   `Please enter a number from 0 to 100`.
93: - Undo/redo is an in-memory, per-workbook snapshot history (cells + validation
94:   rules). Every restore is written to SQLite, so undo/redo state survives refresh;
95:   history itself may reset when the server restarts. A new write after undo clears
96:   the redo branch.
97: - Range copy/cut is a single transaction: cut clears the source and writes the
98:   target together, formulas adjust by the target offset, and every target cell is
99:   validated before anything is written.

101: ## REQ-4 implementation notes
102: 
103: - Formulas are evaluated on read, so results always reflect current sources. The
104:   grid shows `display` (result/error); the formula bar shows the stored `value`
105:   (original expression).
106: - `backend/src/formula.js` exposes `translateFormula` (copy/paste: relative refs
107:   shift, `$` absolute refs do not, out-of-bounds becomes `=#REF!`) and
108:   `rewriteStructureRefs` (row/column insert/delete: every ref at/after the change
109:   moves, absolute refs included; a ref to a deleted line becomes `=#REF!`).
110: - `changeStructure` in `backend/src/services/workbooks.js` rebuilds all cells with
111:   rewritten references and shifts validation-rule rectangles with the structure.
112: - Errors: `#DIV/0!`, `#REF!`, `#NAME?`, `#ERROR!`, circular -> `#REF!`; an error
113:   cell keeps its original formula in the bar and does not block other cells.
114: - Aggregate semantics: blanks ignored, `COUNT` counts numeric cells only,
115:   `SUM/AVERAGE/MIN/MAX` use numeric cells only; `AVERAGE` over no numeric cells is
116:   `#DIV/0!` and `MIN/MAX` are `0` (Google-Sheets-compatible).

118: ## REQ-5 implementation notes
119: 
120: - `backend/src/analysis.js` holds pure helpers: `sortRange` (stable, typed
121:   number/date/text keys, header row excluded, whole rows move together),
122:   `computeHiddenRows`/`conditionMatches` (AND across columns, value or condition),
123:   `distinctValues`, and `computePivot` (first-appearance ordering, Grand Total row
124:   and column, COUNT of non-empty cells, numeric-only SUM/AVERAGE).
125: - Persistence: new `filters` and `pivots` tables in `backend/src/database/init_db.js`.
126:   A worksheet serializes its `filter` plus server-recomputed `hiddenRows`; a
127:   workbook serializes its `pivots`. Sorting writes reordered raw values (formulas
128:   move with their row). Filtering only hides rows; source cells are untouched.
129: - Pivot results are materialized into a separate `PivotN` worksheet; the pivot

131:   ranges with row/column inserts/deletes. Refresh replaces the whole result and
132:   preserves the last good result on error (`Pivot field is no longer available.

134:   source worksheet is rejected with `Please delete or rebuild dependent pivot
